description: The catalogue of major cities ranked for one chart, overall or by chosen life spheres, worldwide or in one region. (Premium or MAX) Use it when the user asks where in the world to live, work or travel; it ranks major cities, optionally by life sphere or region.

time.description: Local birth time, HH:mm, 24-hour. null when unknown: the chart is computed for noon and everything that depends on the time is withheld.

timezone.description: IANA time zone. Leave it out to resolve it from the coordinates; historical daylight-saving rules are applied to the date.

name: best_cities
title: Best cities for a chart
